title: ALPHAMIN REPORTS FATALITY AT MPAMA SOUTH UNDERGROUND MINE

(AFM:TSXV, APH:JSE AltX) (the “Company” or “Alphamin”) deeply regrets to report that an employee of operating subsidiary Alphamin Bisie Mining S.A.
